Dialog.Text: Greetings traveler, I am a humble storyteller. Would you like to hear a tale?

Option.Text: Yes, I'd love to hear a story.
Option.Response: Which story would you like to hear?

Story.Text: Tell me about the Battle of Pendraic.
Story.Response: Ah, the Battle of Pendraic! It was a time of great conflict...

Story.Text: Tell me about the founding of the Empire.
Story.Response: The founding of the Empire is a tale of ambition and glory...
The Noldor, a mysterious and ancient people...

Option.Text: Nevermind, I have to go now.
Option.Response: Very well, traveler. Maybe another time.
